Description
For people who are looking to add silver into their investment portfolio, one of the most popular ways to do so is buying 1 ounce 999 silver rounds.
From the perspective of an investor, buying silver rounds is a great idea for first buyers. Not only are these coins plentiful in terms of minting, but they are very easy to purchase and sell on the market. In short, keeping them as a physical investment is very simple to do with these coins.
While the Asahi Mint is one of the newest private mints in the bullion industry, Asahi Refinery has a history spanning over 200 years. This company is a world leader in the manufacturing of bullion products, producing both gold and silver bars and rounds. A child company of Asahi Holdings based in Japan, the Asahi Refinery purchased Johnson Matthey’s bullion refining facilities located in the US and Canada back in 2015. Asahi Refining continues to entice investors worldwide with its high-quality products. Add an Asahi Round to your portfolio today!
Obverse: Features the official Asahi logo in the center. Inscriptions: “1 OUNCE TROY” and “FINE SILVER .999”.
Reverse: Displays the repeating pattern of the Asahi logo.
